summary.text: Aaron Matson is the Democratic candidate for South Dakota State Senate District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Chris Karr (R).
Matson is a pastor and former adjunct faculty member who taught political science, and he has run for statewide and legislative office before.

paragraphs.text: Aaron Matson was born in Watertown, South Dakota.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Northern State University in 2002, a graduate degree from Trinity Lutheran Seminary in 2008 and a Ph.D. from the University of South Dakota in 2017.
His career experience includes working as a pastor and as an adjunct faculty member at Bellevue University, where he taught political science courses.
Matson was the Democratic nominee for South Dakota Treasurer in 2018 and lost to Josh Haeder (R), receiving 37.7 percent of the vote.
In 2024 he was one of two Democrats on the ballot for the two-seat South Dakota House of Representatives District 11 and was not elected.
